scripts.dev: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.next'); if(fs.existsSync(dir)) { fs.rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true}); }" && next dev
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.next'); if(fs.existsSync(dir)) { fs.rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true}); } console.log('Pasta .next limpa com sucesso');"
